text:
Please contact your vet or a pet poison control hotline right away, before anything else. Pothos is on our not-pet-safe list, so don't wait for symptoms to appear. Have the plant name and roughly how much your dog chewed ready when you call.

I can only share what our policy covers, and it doesn't include treatment guidance, so the vet or poison control is the right source for next steps. Once your dog has been looked after, I'm happy to help with anything else, like pet-safe plant options such as calathea, spider plant, parlour palm, Boston fern, or peperomia.
